durations: Twenty minutes: Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine when the temple struck nine, so it was twenty minutes behind the bell
A moment after he came back: the interval between the doctor's return and the hall clock striking eleven (unquantified)
whereabouts: Madame Monnier and her husband dined together at the table that evening
Her husband sat at the dinner table with his napkin on his knee
Félix was at dinner, where Aurèle scolded him in front of everyone
Monsieur Girard was at dinner and quarrelled with her husband about the repeater
Madame Monnier and Casimir played piquet in the salon after dinner
The doctor left the room, going out to fetch his cigars, which he had left in his coat, at 10:28 by the salon clock
Madame Monnier sat down at the piano in the salon and played Chopin until the doctor came back
The doctor came back into the room, and Madame Monnier stopped playing when he came in
Madame Monnier said she would like to go up to her room (a stated wish, not a report of her having gone)
